title: Things in motion
description: What a thing in motion holds, kind by kind: its content, which Kumo writes, and its state, which your taps write. The kinds are `career`, `body`, `trip`, `project`, `learning` and `other`; `training`, `pursuit`, `occasion` and `case` are 0.18's kinds, still readable, which Kumo reshapes into the new ones. Every item in a list has an `id`, unique within the thing, and Kumo changes a thing one item at a time with `Changes`. A list is named by its field, such as `todo`, or for a list inside an item, such as a day's stops, by that item's id. Every kind can hold Kumo's `notes`, why its plan changed (`reasons`) and, once it ends, its `story`: show the thing's summary as Kumo's line for you, and keep the notes folded, one tap away. Your ticks and choices are keyed by the field their items sit in, such as `todo`, `places` or `sessions`, wherever in the thing they are. The server validates every start and change against its kind here.

ItemId.description: Readable and unique within the thing, such as `book-uffizi` or `sat`.

LocalDateTime.description: A local date and time, such as `2026-11-08T09:12`, in the trip's time zone.

Photo.description: A picture Ari found and kept with `keep_image`. The app shows its credit when you tap it.

source_url.description: The page the picture came from.

credit.description: Who made it, as its source asks.

Location.description: Where it is, for the map.

Booking.description: Whether it needs booking, and where that stands.

Move.description: Getting from one stop to the next, such as a 12 minute walk.

Stop.description: One stop in a day: a visit, a meal, a train.

place.description: The id of its place in `places`, when it has one.

TripDay.description: One day of the trip, its stops in order. Its id names the list of its stops.

TripPlace.description: A place Ari found: a restaurant, a museum, a sight.

why.description: Why Ari chose it, in a line.

status.description: `shortlisted` is an idea, `picked` is in the plan, `passed` is not for you. Your choice, in the state, wins over Ari's, except over `booked`.

TripLeg.description: Getting there and around: a flight, a train, a transfer.

Todo.description: Something left to do. `done` is how Ari wrote it; your tick, in the state, wins. `about` names the items it books, so the app can show them booked the moment you tick it.

about.description: The ids of the stops, legs, stays or places it's about.

Trip.title: trip
Trip.description: A day, a weekend or a longer trip: its days, places, travel, stay and what's left to do.

timezone.description: An IANA time zone, such as `Europe/Rome`.

who.description: Who's going besides you, such as `Mira`.

cover.description: A big photo of the place, for the header and the card.

notes.description: Kumo's working notes, folded on the thing's page.

reasons.description: Why the plan changed, newest first.

story.description: How it ended; written when it's finished.

PlaceChoice.description: Your choice for a place: `shortlisted` (an idea), `picked` (in the plan) or `passed` (not for you). Booking stays Ari's, since it carries a time and a reference.

TripState.description: Your ticks on the to-do list and your choices for places, by item id.

detail.description: Such as `6 × 800 m at 3:50/km · 90 s jog · 2 km warm-up`.

done.description: How Ari wrote it; your tick, in the state, wins.

how.description: How it went, as you told Ari.

TrainingWeek.description: One week of the block, its sessions in order. Its id names the list of its sessions.

note.description: A line from Ari on the week.

Result.description: A result towards the goal, such as a timed 5K, for the best so far and the trend.

Training.title: training
Training.description: 0.18's kind, still readable, for Kumo to reshape: a training block towards a goal, such as a sub-20 5K: the goal, results so far, and every week's sessions.

notes.description: Kumo's working notes, folded on the thing's page.

reasons.description: Why the plan changed, newest first.

story.description: How it ended; written when it's finished.

TrainingState.description: Your ticks on sessions, by session id, in any week.

Link.description: Something to open, such as the invite or the posting, behind a button with its label.

url.description: Such as the posting's page, or the mail as a `message://` link with its Message-ID.

Note.description: One of Kumo's working notes: where a fact came from, what it's unsure of or guessing, how the thing got here, or the ids it finds things by. The app keeps them folded at the bottom of the thing's page, never inline; raw ids, calendar UIDs and mail ids live only here.

tag.description: `source`: where a fact came from. `unsure`: what Kumo isn't sure of. `guess`: a reading, not a fact. `history`: how it got here. `ids`: what Kumo finds things by. Show a tag you don't know as a plain note.

text.description: Such as `The pay range is from your notes on the recruiter's call. Nothing in writing yet.`

Reason.description: Why the plan changed, for you: a change and its reason, such as moving a run after a short night.

change.description: Such as `Moved Thursday's run to Saturday`.

Story.description: How it ended, told short, for History: what happened, what was learnt, and what followed. Kumo writes it when it finishes the thing.

happened.description: A few sentences, such as `You trained five of the eight weeks.`

learnt.description: What was learnt, a line each.

followed.description: What came next, in a line, such as `A fresh hybrid plan`.

followed_by.description: The thing that came next, to open.

Stage.description: Where a role is in the pipeline: a `lead`, `talking` (a first call), `interviewing`, an `offer`, or `ended`. A role is in one stage only, so a live interview is never left among the leads.

Round.description: One round of a role's process, such as the recruiter call or a technical.

Fact.description: A key fact, as a label and a value, such as where the role is or what it pays.

value.description: Such as `London, three days in the office`.

Career.title: career
Career.description: One role in your career pipeline, such as a job you're interviewing for: every role is its own thing, so the pipeline is all of them together, each in one stage.

stages.description: The day it reached each stage it has reached. The server dates the current stage today when it's missing.

facts.description: Key facts, such as how it came about, where, and the pay.

url.description: The posting or the firm's page.

notes.description: Kumo's working notes, folded on the thing's page.

reasons.description: Why the plan changed, newest first.

story.description: How it ended; written when it's finished.

CareerState.description: A role has nothing to tick.

Planned.description: What a session asks for, in numbers where it has them, for planned against done.

pace.description: A pace range per km, such as 6:00 to 6:20.

heart_under.description: Keep the heart rate under this, in bpm.

Pace.description: Minutes and seconds per km, such as `5:59`.

SetDone.description: Sets of one exercise, as recorded from what you said or a workout app.

SessionResult.description: What happened in a session, structured: only what's known, from the Watch or from what you said. The app draws charts only from these, so a chart with no data doesn't show.

source.description: `watch`: a workout record from the Watch. `you`: what you told Kumo.

zones.description: Minutes in each heart-rate zone, from the Watch.

splits.description: Each km's pace, in order, from the Watch.

felt.description: How it felt, in their words, such as `easy, heavy legs at first`.

effort.description: Effort out of 10, as they said.

BodySession.description: One session: what's prescribed, what happened, and Kumo's notes on it, kept apart. Solid shows done, dotted planned, dashed moved or let go.

kind.description: What it is, for its picture. `easy`, `intervals`, `tempo` and `long` are runs and `strength` a lift, from 0.18's training blocks.

plan.description: The prescription, short, such as `30 min easy · heart under 150`.

done.description: How Kumo wrote it; your tick, in the state, wins.

moved_from.description: The day it was planned for before it moved.

let_go.description: Dropped from the plan, not done.

line.description: Kumo's line on how it went, such as `Thirty easy minutes, on plan, and a touch quick.`

changes_next.description: What it changes in the plan, such as `Next week's runs 35 → 40 min`.

how.description: How it went, as you told Kumo, from 0.18.

notes.description: Kumo's notes on the session, folded on its page. Its id names this list.

BodyWeek.description: One week of the block, its sessions in order. Its id names the list of its sessions.

note.description: A line from Kumo on the week.

Body.title: body
Body.description: A training block, as a coach keeps it: the plan, every week's sessions planned against done, results towards a goal, and why the plan changed.

plan.description: The shape of a week, such as `2 lifts and 2 easy runs a week`.

hours_a_week.description: The most time a week the plan should take, in hours.

weeks.description: Every week of the block, first to last.

results.description: Timed efforts towards the goal, oldest first.

notes.description: Kumo's working notes, folded on the thing's page.

reasons.description: Why the plan changed, newest first.

story.description: How it ended; written when it's finished.

BodyState.description: Your ticks on sessions, by session id, in any week.

Part.description: One part of a project or a thing being learnt.

Project.title: project
Project.description: Something being made, in parts, such as a release or a renovation.

aim.description: What it's for, in a line.

notes.description: Kumo's working notes, folded on the thing's page.

reasons.description: Why the plan changed, newest first.

story.description: How it ended; written when it's finished.

ProjectState.description: A project has nothing to tick.

Learning.title: learning
Learning.description: Something being learnt, such as a language or an instrument.

aim.description: Such as `Order and chat in Spanish by the summer`.

notes.description: Kumo's working notes, folded on the thing's page.

reasons.description: Why the plan changed, newest first.

story.description: How it ended; written when it's finished.

Other.title: other
Other.description: Something unfolding over weeks that has no shape yet, such as a visa or a move. A one-off event isn't one; nor is small admin, which lives on the Desk and in Kumo's plans.

about.description: What it is, in a line.

status.description: Where it stands, in a line.

notes.description: Kumo's working notes, folded on the thing's page.

reasons.description: Why the plan changed, newest first.

story.description: How it ended; written when it's finished.

OtherState.description: Your ticks on its to-dos, by item id.

Change.description: One change to one item, or to the thing itself by its own id.

oneOf.title: set
oneOf.description: Set fields of one item; `null` removes a field. With the thing's own id, it sets `title`, `summary`, `pinned`, `salience` or the content's own fields, such as `dates`. Lists change only by add, move and remove.

oneOf.title: add
oneOf.description: Add an item, with its own new id, to a list: after the item named by `after`, or first.

oneOf.title: move
oneOf.description: Move an item after another, or first, in its list or to the list named by `to`.

oneOf.title: remove
oneOf.description: Remove an item, and anything listed inside it.

Changes.description: One change Ari makes: all of it applies, or none of it does.

Person.description: Someone involved, such as a recruiter or a friend coming along.

page.description: Their page in memory, such as `memory:people/tess`.

Next.description: The next step, and when, if it has a time.

end.description: When it ends, if it has a time.

detail.description: A line more, such as `With an engineer from the agents team`.

WaitingOn.description: Who it's waiting on, and since when.

PursuitOption.description: One option being pursued, such as a role at one firm or a flat, moving through stages.

stage.description: Where it stands, in a word or two, such as `Interviews` or `Screened`.

role.description: Such as `Senior AI Engineer`, when `name` is the firm or the flat.

Pursuit.title: pursuit
Pursuit.description: 0.18's kind, still readable, for Kumo to reshape: one outcome, several options moving through stages: a job search, a flat hunt, a raise, a hire. Kumo writes What you're after and How you play it from what you say, and asks when they don't cover a case.

after.description: What you're after, in a line or two.

play.description: How you play it: the rules Kumo follows for you, one a line.

notes.description: Kumo's working notes, folded on the thing's page.

reasons.description: Why the plan changed, newest first.

story.description: How it ended; written when it's finished.

PursuitState.description: A pursuit has nothing to tick.

Occasion.title: occasion
Occasion.description: 0.18's kind, still readable, for Kumo to reshape: a dated event with people and prep: an appointment, a birthday, a dinner, a wedding.

timezone.description: An IANA time zone, such as `Europe/London`.

prep.description: What to do before, oldest first.

check_in.description: Whether Kumo asks how it went afterwards.

all_day.description: A day-long occasion, such as a birthday; its `start` and `end` times don't matter.

notes.description: Kumo's working notes, folded on the thing's page.

reasons.description: Why the plan changed, newest first.

story.description: How it ended; written when it's finished.

OccasionState.description: Your ticks on the prep, by item id.

CaseEntry.description: One moment in a case's back-and-forth.

Case.title: case
Case.description: 0.18's kind, still readable, for Kumo to reshape: a problem with back-and-forth until it's resolved: the boiler, a refund, a visa.

status.description: Where it stands, in a line, such as "Engineer booked for Tuesday".

notes.description: Kumo's working notes, folded on the thing's page.

reasons.description: Why the plan changed, newest first.

story.description: How it ended; written when it's finished.

CaseState.description: A case has nothing to tick.
